title: Hermite polynomial in Gaussian $L^2$
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\alpha:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb N$. Under the product standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$, the image in $L^2$ of the multivariate Hermite polynomial indexed by $\alpha$ is the $L^2$ class of its Hermite function.
hypotheses_covered: $\alpha$ assigns a natural-number index to each coordinate
